articles.summary: Rayonier Inc. (NYSE:RYN) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a $300 million increase to the Company’s existing share repurchase authorization. This increase is in addition to the approximately $51 million that remained under the existing authorization as of October 30, 2026. Repurchases may be made at management’s discretion from time to time on the open market, in privately negotiated transactions, or by other means, including Rule 10b5-1 trading plans.
